status: diagnostic; MPS exact RNG not certified
scope: Stock MPS constructor fails on float64 Gaussian storage. This diagnostic substitutes float32 only for an uncached zero Gaussian field to inspect integer twist; this is not a production workaround. Underlying MPS expression defect not diagnosed.
integration_decision: Start with CPU-owned supplied exact state, explicit reset and fanout, and measured cast-time transfers. No whole-game RNG parity claim without shared ingress and consumer ordering.
